meta.name: elevenlabs-music
meta.description: ElevenLabs AI music generation - create original music from text prompts via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: text-to-music, custom duration up to 10 minutes, genre/mood/instrument control, royalty-free commercial use. Use for: background music, soundtracks, jingles, podcasts, video scores, game audio. Triggers: elevenlabs music, eleven labs music, ai music, generate music, music generation, compose music, ai composer, create song, soundtrack, background music, jingle, elevenlabs compose, music ai

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成原创音乐和音效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成免版税的音乐素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate original music and sound effects from text prompts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need royalty-free music for your projects

howto.what: Claude 可以通过文本描述生成原创音乐，支持指定时长（最长10分钟）、风格、情绪和乐器，生成免版税音乐。
howto.when: 当你提到“生成音乐”、“背景音乐”、“配乐”等关键词，或要求创作歌曲、音效时触发。

say.text: 生成一段30秒的电子舞曲，节奏快，合成器主导。
创作一首2分钟的爵士乐，萨克斯主奏，慢速。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate original music from text prompts, with control over duration (up to 10 minutes), genre, mood, and instruments. Music is royalty-free.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'generate music', 'background music', 'soundtrack', or ask to compose a song.

say_en.text: Generate a 30-second electronic dance track with fast tempo and synths.
Create a 2-minute jazz piece with saxophone lead, slow tempo.
